# Flat inventory of every known .agentic/ path-construction site fixed by
# the DS-171 repo-root anchoring change (Unit 1). One `path:line` per line
# (comments and blank lines ignored). This is the coverage-diff source of
# truth for bin/tests/test_agentic_site_inventory_coverage.py: that test
# re-derives a deliberately OVERINCLUSIVE candidate list of `.agentic`
# path-construction lines across hooks/, hooks/lib/, and bin/, and asserts
# every candidate appears here. A new uninventoried .agentic-constructing
# line fails CI naming the offending line, closing the gap where a future
# hook silently reintroduces cwd-relative .agentic/ writes.
#
# Entries below reflect the POST-FIX line numbers (i.e. the resolver-
# wrapped form, e.g. `path.join(resolveAgenticCwd(cwd), '.agentic', ...)`)
# as they exist in this commit and are MECHANICALLY GENERATED to match the
# scanner's own candidate output exactly (bin/tests/
# test_agentic_site_inventory_coverage.py's _find_candidates()) - do not
# hand-edit line numbers; regenerate via that function after any edit that
# moves a site. The three resolver modules themselves (hooks/lib/
# repo-root.js, hooks/lib/repo_root.py, hooks/lib/repo-root.sh) are
# EXCLUDED - they are what does the resolving, not a site to resolve. Also
# excluded: HOME-scoped sites (never anchored to a project's repo root by
# design) and files using a different, already-correct root-resolution
# mechanism (CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR-based enforce-worktree-{read,write}.py;
# --repo/worktree_path-argument-based bin/ds-reap-worktrees; operator-
# invoked bin/ds-doctor and bin/ds-update). See the scanner's own
# EXCLUDED_FILES / HOME-scope comments for the authoritative rationale.
